...|Beginning of Wave 51}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Controlled''' appeared to be a normal enemy with average speed and low health for its debut. However, it could turn very deadly as it was able to spawn a [[Shrike Crystal]] upon its death, which stunned towers near it. This allowed other enemies to pass through without being attacked by towers, creating a very dangerous situation. ==Appearance== The '''Controlled''' was faceless, aside from a drooling zombie mouth. It had a headcrab on its head and a grey bandanna. The '''Controlled''' had grey diamond-plated wristbands and leg-bands. Its skin was grey, and it had a black pebble torso and legs. == Strategy == *You should not underestimate the '''Controlled''', as it can easily overwhelm your towers due to its ability to spawn [[Shrike Crystal]]s. *The '''Controlled''' spawn in hordes, but while it appears that towers that deal splash damage may be useful, they can lead to your downfall. **This is because the '''Controlleds''' can spawn multiple [[Shrike Crystal]]s, which are immune to splash damage, meaning your towers may get stunned for a while, if you rely on such towers. **Additionally, short range towers like the [[Gladiator]] may not be able to reach the [[Shrike Crystal]]s. *Against the '''Controlled''', high DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], are very effective. **Additionally, the [[Crook|Crooks]] from the [[Crook Boss]] are also useful, but you should not rely on them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} 1b23bd2ad145b214e9f6ce76d6f08a88.jpg|'''Controlled''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Thumb1.jpg|'''Controlled''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} Shrike Development Video - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Controlled''' on a development video. }} == Trivia == *The '''Controlled''' seemed to be a reference to the [[w:c:marvelcinematicuniverse:Shrike|Shrike]] from the ''Marvel Cinematic Universe''. *The '''Controlled's''' design was most likely inspired from the [[w:c:half-life:Standard Zombie|Headcrab Zombie]] from the ''Half-Life'' series. ==Update History== *'''10 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.4|BETA v1.4.0]] **'''Controlled''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Controlled''' removed. {{Hard|[[Molten Boss]]|Wave 50|Controlled|Wave 51|[[Chained Boss|Chained]]|Wave 52}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
